issue.title: Its stuck on the compressing stage
issue.body:
I have been using this amazing tool as an appimage for last few months.  It worked like a charm till a few days ago. Now its stuck on the compressing stage and does not finish compression. I have tried with different files in different locations.  My system configuration is this:

Linux Mint 22.2 Cinnamon
Kernel : 6.14.0-36-generic
AMD Ryzen 7 3750H with Radeon Vega Mobile Gfx × 4
RAM : 22.9 GiB
Nvidia GTX 1650
Display server : x11

Please tell me how to troubleshoot.
